title.zh: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
title.en: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot

current_state.zh: 欧洲央行邀请欧元区线上及移动商户在10月27日前申请参与2027年下半年开始的12个月数字欧元试点，测试beta数字欧元支付，该beta版本不具法定货币地位，参与自愿且无偿。
current_state.en: The ECB is inviting euro-area online and mobile merchants to apply by Oct. 27 for a 12-month digital euro pilot starting in H2 2027, testing beta digital euro payments that will not have legal tender status, with voluntary and unpaid participation.

updates.title_zh: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
updates.title_en: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
updates.what_changed_zh: The European Central Bank is inviting euro-zone e-commerce and mobile merchants to join a 12-month digital euro pilot starting in the second half of 2027, testing a beta CBDC ahead of a possible 2029 issuance.
updates.what_changed_en: The European Central Bank is inviting euro-zone e-commerce and mobile merchants to join a 12-month digital euro pilot starting in the second half of 2027, testing a beta CBDC ahead of a possible 2029 issuance.

updates.title_zh: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
updates.title_en: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增申请截止日期为10月27日，并披露试点细节：beta数字欧元不具法定货币地位、参与自愿且无偿、商户将参与远程/commerce结账测试。
updates.what_changed_en: Added application deadline of Oct. 27 and disclosed pilot details: beta digital euro will not have legal tender status, participation is voluntary and unpaid, and merchants will test remote/commerce checkout use.
updates.current_state_zh: 欧洲央行邀请欧元区线上及移动商户在10月27日前申请参与2027年下半年开始的12个月数字欧元试点，测试beta数字欧元支付，该beta版本不具法定货币地位，参与自愿且无偿。
updates.current_state_en: The ECB is inviting euro-area online and mobile merchants to apply by Oct. 27 for a 12-month digital euro pilot starting in H2 2027, testing beta digital euro payments that will not have legal tender status, with voluntary and unpaid participation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The European Central Bank is inviting euro-area online and mobile merchants to apply by October 27 for a 12-month digital euro pilot expected to begin in the second half of 2027, testing beta payments in e-commerce checkout environments.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The European Central Bank is inviting euro-area online and mobile merchants to apply by October 27 for a 12-month digital euro pilot expected to begin in the second half of 2027, testing beta payments in e-commerce checkout environments.
